text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's raging out there--a storm of cherry blossoms, that is.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what's gonna happen.
But—let's do this, Trainer!

Entering the Oka Sho. If we're keeping our sights
on the Derby next, it's an unthinkable choice.
Now that I've decided to enter, I have to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho... A GⅠ really gets you trembling.
It was just like this during my first Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey Trainer, my way of thinking's changed
a bit since back then.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I thought it was fine to just challenge them and go down in flames.
Trainer told me the same thing, too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you hadn't told me that, I wouldn't have even
been able to run. But now...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I've started thinking that having such a 'do-or-die' attitude
might not actually be a good thing.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
As long as I'm entering, I want to leave results.
Especially if that Scarlet is running too—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna say it's okay to lose.
Charge in aggressively, and win!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thanks! Yeah, that's right,
it's not like I just made my debut anymore.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I don't wanna scatter like cherry blossoms. If I fall
just for that guy to bloom, I'll never rest in peace."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“—Here I am, Scarlet. I came here
instead of the Satsuki Sho just to race with you!”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Show me what you're made of.
And I'll show you what I'm made of!

From looking cool purely through recklessness,
to looking cool with actual strength to back it up.

The first Classic race against her archrival,
Daiwa Scarlet, is about to begin!
